subject: prd/implement-now
statement: When launching a configured reviewer, the executor shall run it in a fresh disposable workspace pinned to the obligation's exact revision, separate from the parent checkout and every implementation/reviewer workspace, with a review-only brief and only the one-way completed-report handoff required by FR-41; reviewer attempts shall use a separately bounded review capacity and shall never consume implementation width, receive proposal credentials or canonical-evidence producer-signing authority, or mutate repository code, the parent checkout, or another workspace.
rationale: release-before-launch is insufficient if reviewers remain mutually concurrent in the live operator clone or can write around the protected persistence boundary
fit_criterion: concurrent-review fixtures never exceed the review bound, hold zero implementation slots, see the exact captured revision, produce no cross-attempt file change, and leave parent/implementation workspaces byte-unchanged; direct proposal/store mutation attempts fail closed while proposal-artifact persistence remains available only through the impl-review-owned broker
